title: In-Place Home Resale Monthly Vacant-Home Check Charge: Desk Posting Card
content:
**Resident desk card — the monthly vacant-home check on an In-Place Home Resale file.** While the file is opened, listed or under contract and the home is vacant, a vacant-home check is required each calendar month, and each month's check is charged within that month on its billing period, dated the first day of the month or, for the month the home became vacant, the day it became vacant. The month charged is the calendar month in progress on the day the check charge is worked out. The day the home became vacant is the date of the seller's accepted occupancy report on the file. Where the package includes the vacant-home check, no vacant-home check charge is posted.

**Effect of posting.** One posting adds one vacant-home check charge for the month given to the file's ledger, dated as given, and raises the fees the seller owes on the file by the amount. The seller sees that month's check among the file's charges and a higher fees-owed figure.

## Invocation

The desk tool is `post_vacant_home_check_55c2c08b`, an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `resale_id` | the resale file number of the home being sold, as shown on the seller's resale file in the in-place resale file lookup | identifier text |
| `billing_period` | the calendar month the check covers | YYYY-MM (four-digit year, two-digit month) |
| `charge_date` | the date the charge is dated on the file | YYYY-MM-DD, a calendar date with no time part and no time zone |
| `amount` | the month's check charge, in USD | a positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; stored exactly as passed |

## Return

On success the tool returns a text rendering of these fields: `status` (the text "posted"), `resale_entry_id` (reference number of the new ledger charge), `resale_id` (the file charged), `charge_type` (always "vacant_home_check"), `billing_period` (the month covered, YYYY-MM), `entry_date` (the charge date, YYYY-MM-DD), `amount` (the charge in USD with 2 decimal places) and `fees_balance` (the fees owed on the file including this charge, USD with 2 decimal places). The tool defines no other receipt.

## Dating the charge (hypothetical file)

The seller's occupancy report recording the home vacant was accepted on 18 April. The April check carries billing period April and is dated 18 April; the May check carries billing period May and is dated 1 May.
